regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate current-method claims. The abstract is a summary and was not treated as a separate experiment. The ESI/CCDC availability statement does not establish a workspace SI association.
Enprostil, fenprostalene, acalycixeniolides E, adenallene, grasshopper ketone 1, and citroside A are biological/context examples, not reaction experiments of this article.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and prior alpha/gamma-addition discussion
regions.finding: Mapped the cited alpha/gamma reaction classes and named Wang/Lin/Li/Zhang/Ni prior work to the Scheme 1 literature records on page 2; no cited external experiment was presented as current work.

unresolved: Figure 1 structures are context rather than syntheses in this paper.
CCDC 2365716 is listed on page 1 but is not explicitly mapped to a compound on pages 1–4; no assignment was inferred.

regions.finding: Classified the generic alpha/gamma map and five cited prior-work arrows as literature examples, and the BTM-mediated 1+2→3 arrow as the current general scheme. None receives a scope-row yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 header, catalyst structures C1–C8, entries 1–8, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Recorded all eight independent optimization rows with shared 1/2 charges, Tol volume, 10 mol% catalyst, room temperature, row catalyst/time, isolated yield, and ee. Prose-explicit >20:1 dr was added only to entries 1 and 5.

Retained the initial unspecified organocatalyst screen as an unresolved main-text summary, linked Table 1 prose to its rows, and merged the 2-MeTHF 87%/90% optimal result with Scheme 2 product 3aa. The text's 25 min conflicts with the Scheme 2 image's 0.5 h and both are retained.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right beginning of Scheme 2 discussion
regions.finding: Mapped 3aa/3ba/3ca outcomes to their page-3 Scheme 2 rows. The tert-butyl R limitation is a separate failure row because the mixture and non-isolation of 3da are explicit, while exact SI Scheme S1 details remain unavailable.

unresolved: Unassociated ESI Tables S1/S2 and Scheme S1 were not imported.
Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, product masses, and row dr values except where stated in prose.
3aa reaction time conflicts between page-2 prose (25 min) and page-3 Scheme 2 (0.5 h).

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Scheme 2 header, products 3aa/3ba/3ca, CCDC label, and caption
regions.finding: Recorded three distinct alkoxy-group scope experiments with shared charges/conditions, isolated yields, >20:1 dr, and ee. 3ab X-ray assignment/CCDC 2365715 is linked as characterization provenance; 3aa retains the 0.5 h versus 25 min source conflict.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 3 header, 27-product grid, and caption
regions.finding: Recorded every displayed product 3ea–3pa, 3ab–3ag, and 3ah–3ap as an independent scope experiment with exact isolated yield and ee, common >20:1 dr, charges, catalyst, solvent, and room temperature. Exact row times are absent and remain null/missing.

regions.region: page 3 upper prose on configuration and substrate scope
regions.finding: The (3S,5S) assignment of 3ab is linked to its scope record; other configurations are assigned by source analogy but no machine structures were verified. Aggregate scope prose was not duplicated as experiments.
Recorded separate 2 mmol-scale 3ea and 3ah experiments with displayed masses, 1.5 h, 60%/70% yields, >20:1 dr, and 90%/88% ee. They remain distinct from the 0.10 mmol scope rows.

Recorded isolated 3ea→4ea (12 h, 68%, racemic, Z/E 1.5:1) and the separate one-pot precursor→4ea route (32 h, 81%, Z/E 1.5:1). The one-pot row is not assigned the racemic label printed with the first result.

The successful ESI-only 4ba/generalization statements were not expanded into unseen rows. The sentence introducing several failed derivative attempts continues on page 4 and is represented once as an unresolved summary.

unresolved: Scheme 3 gives no exact product-specific reaction times, workups, purifications, masses, or atmosphere.
CCDC 2365716 is not explicitly mapped to 4ba or another compound on the covered pages.
Unassociated ESI Schemes S3/S4 were not imported as reaction rows.

regions.finding: Classified the C5/2a/1a cycle and proposed intermediates I–III as one mechanism record, not preparations. The text describes deprotonation/hydrogen bonding, gamma-site attack, proton transfer, product release, and catalyst regeneration.

The page completes the statement that several other derivative attempts failed. Because all identities and conditions are assigned to unassociated ESI Scheme S4, only an unresolved failure summary is retained.

regions.region: page 4 conclusion, data availability, conflicts, and references
regions.finding: Conclusion restates aggregate maxima and the scale-up/derivatization claims without defining new experiments. Data availability and bibliography do not establish workspace SI association; external cited papers were not imported as current-paper experiments.

unresolved: No exact failed-derivatization rows can be reconstructed without the unassociated ESI.
Proposed intermediates I–III are not independently observed.
No new reaction operation or experiment-specific yield occurs in the conclusion or references.
